tool_input_args.value:
# Fix: use \r\n split and correct column names (rep_name, status)
lines = csv_content.strip().split('\n')
cols = [c.strip() for c in lines[0].split(',')]

james_won = []
sofia_won = []

for line in lines[1:]:
    fields = [f.strip() for f in line.split(',')]
    row = dict(zip(cols, fields))
    
    rep = row.get('rep_name', '')
    deal_status = row.get('status', '')
    
    if deal_status.lower() == 'won':
        if rep == 'James Okafor':
            james_won.append(row)
        elif rep == 'Sofia Delgado':
            sofia_won.append(row)

# Format output
print("=== JAMES OKAFOR — Won Deals ===")
print(f"{'Deal ID':<10} {'Region':<8} {'Product':<28} {'Amount':>10} {'Close Date':<12}")
print("-" * 72)
james_total = 0
for d in james_won:
    amt = int(d['amount'])
    james_total += amt
    print(f"{d['deal_id']:<10} {d['region']:<8} {d['product']:<28} ${amt:>9,} {d['close_date']:<12}")
print(f"\n{'Deals:':<10} {len(james_won)}    |    Total Revenue: ${james_total:,}\n")

print("=== SOFIA DELGADO — Won Deals ===")
print(f"{'Deal ID':<10} {'Region':<8} {'Product':<28} {'Amount':>10} {'Close Date':<12}")
print("-" * 72)
sofia_total = 0
for d in sofia_won:
    amt = int(d['amount'])
    sofia_total += amt
    print(f"{d['deal_id']:<10} {d['region']:<8} {d['product']:<28} ${amt:>9,} {d['close_date']:<12}")
print(f"\n{'Deals:':<10} {len(sofia_won)}    |    Total Revenue: ${sofia_total:,}")
